title: Phuket — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Phuket: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Phuket has a population of 600,000. Thailand’s largest island offers stunning beaches, world-class diving, a vibrant expat community, and a tropical lifestyle at a fraction of comparable island destinations. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8a growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers. Sunshine is limited, with about 50 sunny days a year.

Last updated: November 07, 2026
